meta.libraryPositioning: Company-preferred visualization catalog. These are custom in-house infographic, roadmap, and framework templates. They are consulted BEFORE the stock charts_index.json: for each visualization page, match this catalog first; if an entry's Pick clause fits the page's content shape, use it; only pages with no company match fall through to the 81-template stock catalog. See references/strategist.md §VII 'Company catalog first'.
meta.summaryGrammar: Each entry's `summary` is a selection rule, not a description. Format: 'Pick for <content shape + scale>. Skip for <reason → alternative>'. Match every visualization page's content shape against these summaries before the stock catalog.

03_process_flow.summary: Pick for linear processes, sequential steps, workflows, deployment phases (3-7 numbered steps). Skip for cyclical/iterative loops (use 07_cycle) or branching causal flows (use 22_sankey).

04_timeline.summary: Pick for milestones, roadmaps, and time-ordered events on a single horizontal axis. Skip for multi-stream quarterly plans (use 23_quarterly_product_roadmap) or calendar grids (use 28_monthly_marketing_calendar).

05_comparison.summary: Pick for two-option comparison, pros/cons, side-by-side evaluation across consistent attributes. Skip for 3+ options or single-axis ranking (use 06_pyramid).

06_pyramid.summary: Pick for ranking, stratification, layered hierarchy, and maturity levels. Skip for reporting-line org structures (use 11_org_tree).

07_cycle.summary: Pick for iterative loops, flywheels, PDCA, and continuous feedback cycles. Skip for one-directional linear steps (use 03_process_flow).

08_matrix_2x2.summary: Pick for sorting items across two axes (High/Low), BCG-style prioritization. Skip for labelled SWOT quadrants (use 18_swot) or 3x3 grids (use 30_marketing_milestones_matrix).

09_pillars.summary: Pick for core strategic pillars, corporate tenets, and organizational foundations. Skip for sequential steps (use 03_process_flow).

10_funnel.summary: Pick for conversion funnels, sales pipelines, and monotonic stage drop-off. Skip for non-decreasing or branching flows.

11_org_tree.summary: Pick for org charts, OKR cascades, work breakdown structures, and parent-child hierarchy. Skip for non-hierarchical concept networks (use 15_mind_map).

12_venn.summary: Pick for set overlaps, intersections, and shared/overlapping areas. Skip for non-overlapping categories.

13_kpi_highlight.summary: Pick for KPI summary cards, key-metric dashboards, and financial highlights with direction. Skip for a single metric vs a target (use 20_gauge).

14_gantt.summary: Pick for project plans and task schedules with durations and phases across swimlanes. Skip for high-level milestone-only timelines (use 04_timeline).

15_mind_map.summary: Pick for brainstorms, radial concept maps, product modules, and non-linear categories. Skip for strict reporting hierarchy (use 11_org_tree).

16_geo_map.summary: Pick for geographic regions, office locations, and spatial or global-scale data. Skip for non-spatial data.

17_waterfall.summary: Pick for additive/subtractive financial variances, budget bridges, and stepwise totals. Skip for cumulative time-series trends.

18_swot.summary: Pick for SWOT (Strengths/Weaknesses/Opportunities/Threats) and internal-vs-external, positive-vs-negative assessment. Skip for generic 2x2 prioritization (use 08_matrix_2x2).

19_fishbone.summary: Pick for root-cause analysis, Ishikawa cause-and-effect, and quality diagnosis. Skip for sequential processes (use 03_process_flow).

20_gauge.summary: Pick for a single KPI vs target, goal-completion dial, or speedometer metric. Skip for multiple KPIs (use 13_kpi_highlight).

21_heat_map.summary: Pick for risk matrices, value-intensity grids across row/column headers, and cohort retention. Skip for single-series charts.

22_sankey.summary: Pick for resource/energy flows and magnitude branching from sources to targets. Skip for simple linear steps (use 03_process_flow).

23_quarterly_product_roadmap.summary: Pick for 4-quarter (Q1-Q4) roadmaps grouped by streams or focus areas. Skip for monthly granularity (use 24_monthly_strategic_roadmap).

24_monthly_strategic_roadmap.summary: Pick for phased monthly execution roadmaps with activities/outcomes per phase. Skip for quarter-level (use 23_quarterly_product_roadmap) or multi-year (use 25_yearly_strategic_goals_roadmap).

25_yearly_strategic_goals_roadmap.summary: Pick for multiple strategic goals mapped to milestone years/targets and multi-year objectives. Skip for sub-annual execution plans.

26_annual_roles_targets_roadmap.summary: Pick for multi-year roadmaps organized by execution pillars (roles, action plans, targets). Skip for simple single-axis timelines (use 04_timeline).

27_three_year_project_lifecycle.summary: Pick for 3-year project lifecycle phases (e.g. Planning/Execution/Monitoring) and multi-year phase tracks. Skip for single-year plans.

28_monthly_marketing_calendar.summary: Pick for monthly calendar grids of campaign events, editorial schedules, and sprint planners. Skip for non-calendar timelines (use 04_timeline).

29_cross_functional_status_board.summary: Pick for Kanban/status boards, 4-column task trackers, and cross-functional status. Skip for scheduled Gantt durations (use 14_gantt).

30_marketing_milestones_matrix.summary: Pick for 3x3 matrices, 9-item grids grouped under 3 categories, and grouped milestone cards. Skip for 2x2 prioritization (use 08_matrix_2x2).

31_maturity_transformation_roadmap.summary: Pick for maturity curves, capability-growth progression, and 4-stage transformation roadmaps. Skip for calendar or quarter plans.

32_multi_year_growth_strategy.summary: Pick for 5-year/5-phase growth strategies with stacked key objectives and long-term projections. Skip for short-term plans (use 24_monthly_strategic_roadmap).
